input: Map out all upcoming family birthdays this year

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Family can mean immediate household, extended family, or even close family friends — this determines how many birthdays are in scope and how much research is needed.
Knowing who will use or contribute to this list affects whether it is a solo effort or a collaborative one, and how it needs to be shared.
The starting point matters — if some birthdays are already known and recorded somewhere, the task is about filling gaps rather than starting from scratch.
A time constraint (e.g., needing this done before a specific date or event) would affect how quickly sources need to be contacted and information gathered.
The tool or format used (calendar app, spreadsheet, physical planner, etc.) determines the exact steps needed to complete and maintain the list.
Just listing dates is different from also including reminders, gift ideas, or age milestones — knowing what 'done well' looks like shapes the depth of the output.
Some people want advance reminders set weeks ahead; others just want a simple one-time reference — this affects how the list is structured and how proactive the system needs to be.

gold.taskTitle: Map out all upcoming family birthdays this year
gold.taskDescription: Collect, organise, and track every upcoming family birthday remaining in the current calendar year.

questions.title: Which family members are you including in this list?
questions.description: Clarify whether the scope covers only immediate family (parents, siblings, children), extended family (grandparents, aunts, uncles, cousins), or a broader circle.

questions.title: Is this list just for you or shared with others?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a personal reference or something to be shared with a partner, co-parent, or other family members.

questions.title: Do you already have some birthdays recorded somewhere?
questions.description: Find out if there is an existing source (old calendar, contacts app, group chat) to pull from, or if everything needs to be gathered from scratch.

questions.title: Is there a specific date you need this completed by?
questions.description: Identify any deadline driving urgency, such as an upcoming birthday that is soon or a family event where the list is needed.

questions.title: Where do you want to store or display the final list?
questions.description: Determine the intended format or tool — for example a phone calendar, a spreadsheet, a notes app, or a physical planner.

questions.title: Should the list include anything beyond just names and dates?
questions.description: Clarify whether extra details are wanted, such as ages turning, gift ideas, or links to wish lists, to define the depth of the output.

questions.title: How far in advance do you want to be reminded?
questions.description: Establish the preferred lead time for alerts or reminders — for example one week before, one month before, or no reminders at all.
